name: pscat
description: PostScript rendering, generative art and paper-ready charts with the pscat interpreter: three skills plus the pscat-mcp server. Uses your installed pscat, or downloads the prebuilt one from the project's GitHub releases on first start.

interface.shortDescription: Render PostScript to PNG, SVG and PDF; make generative art and charts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Draw a small generative art piece in PostScript with pscat and render it to PNG.
